purpose: Defines how doc-link is composed of eight SKILLs and two custom Agents: responsibilities, per-SKILL sequences, the operational flow, and the data exchange with Agents.
summary: Lists the eight SKILLs (embed-dlid, index-docs, query-docs, resolve-dlid, check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, check-impact) with kind, write scope to documents, state changes, and requirements
Describes the two custom Agents: toc-updater (generates document info, max 3 documents per launch) and query-worker (read-only search over the confirmed ToC)
Specifies responsibilities of operation and lookup SKILLs: DLID embedding, ToC build, search, and DLID resolution
Specifies what each check SKILL detects and who handles the findings, including check-impact reporting per changed document with direct referrers only
Gives the use-case diagram and a sequence diagram for each SKILL (embed-dlid through resolve-dlid)
Defines the common operational flow starting from index-docs: check-dlid, embed-dlid, check-links, index-docs, check-impact, with reasons for the ordering
Defines the instructions for the project management AI after check-impact: judge each referrer, fix, rewrite title content hash only for verified references, and repeat until empty
Defines the request/result exchange with custom Agents: identifiers, request and result contents, error value source_unreadable, script validation, and deletion timing
tasks: Designing or changing SKILL and custom Agent composition
Implementing or modifying a doc-link SKILL.md or its scripts
Implementing toc-updater or query-worker Agent behavior
Deciding the order of SKILL execution in the operational flow
Handling check-impact results and rewriting title content hashes
Designing the data exchange between SKILLs and Agents
Reviewing consistency between requirements and SKILL design
title: DES-010 SKILL と Agent の構成
